evidence.mission_note: As a future keeper this is the preferred S52 manual M Roadster inside the ideal price band, but the keeper brief demands documentation and this listing offers none yet. Its appeal rests on photos and seller prose until the VIN, structure and cooling evidence arrive.
evidence.rationale: The photos establish a genuine Z3 M Roadster with a manual gearbox, a stock-looking M Power engine bay, an apparently good soft top and wheels, and an odometer showing 63,182 miles, consistent with the stated 63,000. Observed wear includes hazy headlight lenses, a creased and worn driver seat bolster, and an expansion tank that looks aged, which hints that the cooling plastics may never have been refreshed. Everything else rests on seller statements: clean title, two owners, no damage, completely stock, and a new clutch, tires and battery, with no VIN, receipts or history report behind any of it. Both model-critical items that apply to this S52 car, rear structure and cooling history, are missing. The S54 rod-bearing item does not apply. The $18,900 ask matches the fair-value midpoint, while the OBO terms and 31 weeks of relisting suggest negotiating room. The car is in Florida, so PPI access before payment remains to be confirmed.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, the clutch invoice, tire date-code photos, trunk-floor and underside photos, and confirmation that an independent BMW-specialist PPI can be done before any deposit.
